scope: T10A01/T10B01: every defect found by the clean-clone check and rehearsal 1 so far is closed with a named test. None is deferred; the rehearsal continues and any new defect gets its own row and test.

defects.defect: the public audit page stayed on Loading forever for a logged-out visitor because the global 401 handler cleared the read cache and cancelled the page's own public reads
defects.fix: frontend/src/shared/lib/session.ts clears cached reads only when a signed-in session ends; the session-ended signal still fires for the route guard
defects.test: frontend/tests/session.cache.test.ts and the unmodified session.guard.test.tsx; verified in a browser against a closed pool (rules, entry list and seal 75 all verify)

defects.defect: make setup failed in a fresh clone because the hashed lock pins pip itself and the pip launcher refuses to modify it
defects.fix: the Makefile installs the lock through python -m pip
defects.test: clean clone at f5d0852: make setup exit 0, make verify exit 0

defects.defect: the machine default python is 3.14, so make setup refused before creating the venv; the README did not say how to select 3.12
defects.fix: the README run steps show make setup PYTHON=<path to a 3.12 interpreter>
defects.test: clean clone with PYTHON set to the 3.12 environment

defects.defect: the exported Merchant document stated the bid body's confirmed as const:true; APIMatic generated the SDKs with the string "True", which the server rejects
defects.fix: tools/export_merchant_openapi.py states it as type boolean and the spec/SDKs were regenerated

defects.defect: two checkout tests failed only in CI: the retry button was asserted with getByRole before the error state settled, and the file's afterEach restored mocks before the global cleanup unmounted components
defects.fix: await the retry button; unmount first and use mockClear so a promise-returning default stays in place
defects.test: frontend/tests/checkout.behavior.test.tsx, eight consecutive local runs and CI green on f0d4c20

defects.defect: the live quote parse discarded the whole proposal when Gemini returned a date-only valid_until
defects.fix: Quote normalises a date-only valid_until to the end of that day UTC; explicit timestamps pass unchanged and a naive timestamp is still refused

defects.defect: the quote grounding accepted only the literal words capacity and minimum order quantity, rejecting a natural quote that said supply 12 units and minimum order 3
defects.fix: the capacity and MOQ labels also read supply and minimum order

proves: each closed row names a regression test or a recorded run that would fail again if the fix were removed
does_not_prove: that the full live storyboard and the recorded video are complete; that remains in rehearsal_1.json and video.json
